# Block O'Toole & Murphy

> A premier personal injury law firm in New York and New Jersey specializing in high-value accident cases, verdicts, and settlements.

Block O'Toole & Murphy is a tier 1 personal injury law firm based in New York City, representing clients on a contingency basis. The firm is known for securing substantial verdicts and settlements exceeding $1 million in complex injury cases across NY and NJ.
